newsitem.title: FRANCE: Police detain anti-nuclear demonstrators in Paris.
newsitem.headline: Police detain anti-nuclear demonstrators in Paris.

text.p: French police detained nine demonstrators on Thursday after they set down four containers packed with what they said was radioactive earth outside the National Assembly in Paris.
Witnesses said the environmentalists had chained themselves to the containers and unrolled a banner reading "Let's get out of Nuclear" on the gates of the lower house by the river Seine.
"We want to raise the awareness of the public and of politicians, a few weeks away from parliamentary elections, and to demand a rapid exit from nuclear energy," one demonstrator told reporters.
President Jacques Chirac has called an early parliamentary election, with the first round of voting set for May 25 and a runoff on June 1.
